purpose: Estimate semantic context value with Jev and apply deterministic local retention policy without generative summarization.
invariants: user_text and assistant_text are never model-rewritten
recoverability is determined by local code or caller metadata, not by Jev
nonrecoverable failure evidence is PINned until verification PASS unless an explicit lease overrides it
ANCHOR is deterministic metadata plus an original-content prefix, never a generated summary
shadow mode applies no ANCHOR or DROP operation
automatic ContextEngine mode preserves tool-call/result protocol structure
input order is preserved among retained evidence
